Question 2

Find the Cartesian equation of the parabola defined by the parametric equations

x+3=2t,y−2=t2,t∈(−∞,∞).

a
(x+3)2=2(y−2)
b
(x+3)2=4(y−2)
c
(x−3)2=2(y+2)
d
(x−3)2=4(y+2)
e
(x+3)2=8(y−2)
